info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Connect Components Institution Login Form-v5-spec
info.description: The Institution Login Form Creation API allows institutions to efficiently create and customize login forms for their users. This endpoint takes specific institution identifiers and facilitates the submission of tailored login configurations, enabling a seamless authentication experience. Typical consumers of this API include educational institutions, corporate partners, or service providers looking to integrate login functionality into their systems. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance user engagement while maintaining security and brand consistency.

post.summary: Submit a login form for the specified institution.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit their login credentials for the institution with ID RES-100045. It processes the login details and returns the appropriate response based on the authentication success or failure.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit login form data for the specified institution. It requires the necessary credentials and any additional parameters needed for the login process.
